rows.label: S — Safe technique
rows.value: Read-only, non-destructive, targeted. One request where one is sufficient. Never a scanner verification module.

rows.label: A — Advisory alignment
rows.value: The technique and its expected result must match what the vendor advisory says a vulnerable vs patched server does.

rows.label: F — Feature confirmed
rows.value: The specific configuration condition required by the CVE must be verified as present. For CVE-2021-41773: mod_cgi status, directory access controls.

rows.label: E — Evidence documented
rows.value: Exact technique, exact response, exact conclusion — recorded in the engagement log with timestamps and evidence.

rows.label: Path traversal test
rows.value: curl http://[ip]/cgi-bin/.%2e/.%2e/.%2e/etc/passwd — HTTP 200 = traversal confirmed; HTTP 400 = rejected (possible backport); HTTP 403 = directory protected

rows.label: mod_cgi check
rows.value: curl -I http://[ip]/cgi-bin/ — HTTP 403 = cgi-bin configured (mod_cgi likely present); HTTP 404 = cgi-bin not configured

rows.label: Banner check
rows.value: curl -I http://[ip] — look for distribution suffix: (Red Hat), (Debian), (Ubuntu) indicates a managed package with possible backport

rows.label: Advisory confirmation
rows.value: httpd.apache.org/security/vulnerabilities_24.html — check the specific advisory for configuration indicators

sections.heading: Interpreting HTTP Response Codes During Validation

rows.label: HTTP 200
rows.value: Server processed the request — path traversal worked, file was accessed

rows.label: HTTP 400 Bad Request
rows.value: Server rejected the URL as malformed — consistent with a patched server rejecting the traversal sequence

rows.label: HTTP 403 Forbidden
rows.value: Server recognised the path but denied access — directory exists but listing/access is protected

rows.label: HTTP 404 Not Found
rows.value: The target path does not exist in the server's view — cgi-bin not configured, or the path is fully blocked

rows.label: Distribution suffix
rows.value: Apache/2.4.49 (Red Hat), Apache/2.4.49 (Debian) — managed package that may have backport applied

rows.label: HTTP 400 on traversal
rows.value: Server rejects the %2e traversal URL — consistent with backport that fixes path normalisation at the parsing stage

rows.label: Distribution advisory
rows.value: RHSA-2021:3610 (Red Hat), DSA-4982 (Debian) — confirms whether backport was applied to the distribution's httpd package

rows.label: Peak operational periods
rows.value: End of month, release windows, peak trading hours — validation can wait; unnecessary risk to operations

rows.label: Outside authorisation scope
rows.value: The action is not explicitly covered by the engagement authorisation letter or rules of engagement

rows.label: Target under stress
rows.value: Unusual system behaviour suggests the target may already be in an incident or degraded state

rows.label: Technique could disrupt service
rows.value: If there is any question whether the technique could affect availability, defer to client confirmation first
